title: Buff Up (Bootleg FFF)
author: ThePedallingPianist
rules:
This is my response to Scojo's setting prompt from 26th September 2026, for which aqjhs asked setters to explore U-Bahn.

While I do have history making puzzles that simultaneously fit the description of being a response to a Setting Saturdays prompt and an entry to the Fortress Fillomino Fridays series (the Hitlines episode, for example), this puzzle definitely seems to belong more to the former category than the latter. Because of this, and the fact that I'm in the very fortunate position of having Fortress Fillominos submitted from guest setters to keep the series going until next year, I'll happily open up a slot by keeping this out of FFF!

FORTRESS FILLOMINO:

• The groups of orthogonally connected white cells outside the main 6x6 grid are Fortress Fillomino areas;

• Divide these areas into orthogonally connected regions and fill each cell with the number of cells in the region to which it belongs;

• Each region must be either strictly larger than all of its orthogonal neighbours or strictly smaller than all of its orthogonal neighbours.

U-BAHN:

• Draw a loop network through the centers of some cells, which may branch or turn, but may not have any dead ends;

• A number outside the grid indicates how many times the corresponding line shape (i.e. a cross, branch, straight line, or turn) appears in the corresponding row or column, irrespective of the line shape's rotation.

▶ Penpa

▶ SudokuPad
solutionCode: For all rows except the last (starting at the top row), the number of line segments going down from that row
